quote.text: Soon the river Euphrates will disclose the treasure (the mountain) of gold, so whoever will be present at that time should not take anything of it.

shots.framing: HOOK (flash-forward). Wide: a dry, cracked riverbed between high banks; THOUSANDS of small silhouettes line both banks, all frozen, staring at one tiny golden glint in the mud at centre; a man in the foreground lifts a boy onto his shoulders
shots.camera: Very slow push-in toward the glint
shots.vo_markup: The *Euphrates* had flowed for ten thousand years.
shots.vo: The Euphrates had flowed for ten thousand years.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The crowd staring, the glint pulsing
shots.notes: Alive from frame 0: dust drifting, people shifting weight, heat haze. The glint flares on "Euphrates".

shots.framing: Medium: an old fisherman (70s, grey stubble, rolled trousers) pushes his wooden boat into the river, but there is no water: the hull scrapes on cracked mud and stops dead
shots.vo: Then, in one summer, it stopped.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: His shoulders shoving, the hull jolting to a halt
shots.notes: Hull halts on "stopped"; he straightens and stares down the empty riverbed.

shots.framing: Wide: a row of painted wooden boats stranded on cracked mud, tilted; a young boatman jumps down from one, his feet crack the crust
shots.camera: Slow lateral track along the boats
shots.vo_markup: First, the boats sat on the *mud.*
shots.vo: First, the boats sat on the mud.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The jump and the crust cracking
shots.notes: Feet land on "mud" (a puff of dust, cracks spread).

shots.framing: Medium-low: a shrinking pool full of silver fish flopping; two kids with buckets stand at its edge not knowing where to start
shots.vo_markup: Then the fish came up gasping, by the *thousands.*
shots.vo: Then the fish came up gasping, by the thousands.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Silver fish flashing, the kids frozen with buckets
shots.notes: On "thousands" reveal how far the fish carpet goes (camera rises).

shots.framing: Medium: a family loads a pickup truck: a father heaves a rolled mattress, a mother ties a rope over pots and a bicycle, a girl carries a caged hen; a dry hand-pump well in the foreground
shots.vo_markup: The wells went dry. Whole villages loaded their lives onto *trucks.*
shots.vo: The wells went dry. Whole villages loaded their lives onto trucks.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Dry pump handle, father heaving the mattress
shots.notes: Pump handle squeaks dry on "dry"; rope pulled tight on "trucks".

shots.framing: Medium: a water tanker truck mobbed by hands holding jerrycans; a labourer (40s, cement dust on his clothes) empties all his coins into the driver's palm for one can
shots.vo_markup: A can of water cost more than a day's *work.*
shots.vo: A can of water cost more than a day's work.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Coins pouring into the palm
shots.notes: Last coin drops on "work"; the driver hands one can down.

shots.framing: Aerial wide: a vast desert; the river reduced to a thin brown thread winding through a broad pale scar of its old bed; tiny trucks crawl along the road beside it
shots.vo_markup: And the great river shrank to a thin brown *thread.*
shots.vo: And the great river shrank to a thin brown thread.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The thread of water
shots.notes: On "thread" the last shimmer of water thins (subtle animation of the line).

shots.framing: Medium: a farmer (50s, headcloth) kneels in a cracked, dead field and crumbles a dry stalk in his fist; the dust blows away; his young son stands behind with an empty bucket
shots.vo_markup: In the cities, water came by the cupful. In the fields, nothing *grew.*
shots.vo: In the cities, water came by the cupful. In the fields, nothing grew.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The stalk crumbling to dust
shots.notes: Dust blows off his palm on "grew".

shots.framing: Medium: a shaded courtyard; an old man (80s, white beard, simple white cap) with prayer beads; the beads stop; he slowly lifts his eyes toward the river
shots.vo_markup: And the old men began to *remember.*
shots.vo: And the old men began to remember.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Beads stopping, eyes lifting
shots.notes: Beads stop on "remember".

shots.framing: Medium: night, lamplight; the old man speaks to three grandchildren sitting close; his hands trace the shape of a mountain in the air
shots.vo_markup: Fourteen centuries ago, the Prophet said this river would one day uncover a mountain of *gold.*
shots.vo: Fourteen centuries ago, the Prophet said this river would one day uncover a mountain of gold.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: His hands shaping a mountain, kids leaning in
shots.notes: Hands peak on "gold"; lamp flickers.

shots.framing: Wide: the empty dry riverbed under a deep night sky, moonlight on the cracks; one lone figure (the old man) stands small on the bank looking down at it
shots.vo_markup: And he left one warning: whoever is there should take *nothing* from it.
shots.vo: And he left one warning: whoever is there should take nothing from it.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Moonlit cracks, the lone figure
shots.notes: QUOTE overlay on this shot: keep the top ~15–40% dark and calm. The figure turns away on "nothing".

shots.framing: Medium: young men at a roadside tea stall; one mimics the old man's mountain gesture, the others burst out laughing, slapping the table
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The mocking gesture and the laugh
shots.notes: The laugh bursts on "laughed".

shots.framing: Medium-wide: a girl (9, two braids, faded dress) runs after a small goat across the cracked riverbed; she stops dead and turns: a glint in the mud
shots.vo_markup: Then a girl chasing her goat across the riverbed saw something *shine.*
shots.vo: Then a girl chasing her goat across the riverbed saw something shine.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Running girl, the goat, the glint
shots.notes: Glint flares on "shine"; she freezes.

shots.framing: Close: her small hands scraping mud away; a smooth yellow edge appears and keeps going, wider and wider under her fingers
shots.vo_markup: She dug with her hands. It didn't *end.*
shots.vo: She dug with her hands. It didn't end.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Hands scraping, gold widening
shots.notes: On "end" her hands stop: the gold runs past both edges of the frame.

shots.framing: Wide: her father with a shovel digging beside her; behind him dozens of villagers run down the bank with shovels, hoes, bare hands
shots.vo_markup: Her father dug. Then the whole village *dug.*
shots.vo: Her father dug. Then the whole village dug.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Father's shovel, the crowd running down
shots.notes: Crowd hits the riverbed on "dug".

shots.framing: Extreme wide: a huge curved surface of raw gold emerging from the mud like the back of a buried mountain; the villagers tiny on top of it, stunned, shovels lowered
shots.camera: Slow tilt down then crane up
shots.vo_markup: It wasn't a coin. It wasn't a nugget. It went down further than anyone could *see.*
shots.vo: It wasn't a coin. It wasn't a nugget. It went down further than anyone could see.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The scale: tiny people on gold
shots.notes: On "see" the crane rises to reveal the full curve.

shots.framing: Wide: sunset; the villagers sit and stand on the curved gold surface, stunned; an old woman touches it with her palm, kids slide down it, the girl and her goat at the centre, long shadows
shots.vo_markup: By sunset, the poorest village on the river was sitting on more gold than every king in *history.*
shots.vo: By sunset, the poorest village on the river was sitting on more gold than every king in history.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Poor villagers on a mountain of gold
shots.notes: On "history" the low sun flares off the gold.

shots.framing: Wide: desert night; headlights converge from every horizon along roads toward the river; a roadside tea stall radio glows, a trucker swings his wheel
shots.vo_markup: By nightfall, the news had crossed every *border.*
shots.vo: By nightfall, the news had crossed every border.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Streams of headlights
shots.notes: Headlights multiply on "border".

shots.framing: Extreme wide: dawn; endless lines of people walking across the desert toward the riverbed, carrying shovels, sacks, children on shoulders; dust lit gold
shots.vo_markup: By morning, a *million* people were walking toward the river.
shots.vo: By morning, a million people were walking toward the river.
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: The endless lines
shots.notes: CLIFFHANGER: heartbeat. Reveal on "million" (camera rises over the lines).

shots.framing: TITLE CARD: "THE RIVER RUNS DRY" + "CHAPTER 6 · THE LAST DAYS" over a dark riverbed with a faint gold glint
shots.speaker: narr
shots.hero: Title
shots.notes: Deep bass drop on the cut.
